paite: Huchiin, a ta deihtakte bangin Pathian omdan late hi un;
english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

paite: Huan, Krisin a honit a, namtui dinga Pathian kianga thilpiak ding leh kithoihna dinga i sika dia a kipiak bang mahin itnaah om un.
english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

paite: Himahleh, mi siangthoute hiha kilawm himin kingaih leh sianglou tengteng huaihamna toh, na lak uah loh khakin om kei hen.
english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

paite: Zahmohte, thuginalou gente, chiamniuh thu nangawn huaite bang a kilawm lou hi; huaite hih sangin kipahthu gen jaw un.
english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate; but rather giving of thanks.

paite: Kingaihhat leh mi thanghuai leh, mi huaiham himhimin (mi huaiham jaw milim bemi a hi) Kris leh Pathian gamah tanding himhim a neikei uh chih na thei mahmah ngal ua.
english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

paite: Kuamahin thuginalou peuhin honkhem kei uhen; huai thilte jiakin Pathian thangpaihna tuh thumanglou tate tungah a tung naknak ahi.
english: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

paite: Huaijiakin amau kikoppih kei un.
english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

paite: Tuma lamin mial na hi ua, tun jaw Toupa ah vak na honghita uhi; vak tate bangin om un;
english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

paite: Vak gah tuh hoihna leh, diktatna leh, thutak tengteng ahi;
english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

paite: Toupa kipahna lamtak bang ahi hiam zong un.
english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

paite: Huan, mial thilhih gah nei ngei loute ah leng panna himhim neikei unla, pan naksangin a diklouhdan uh theisak jaw un.
english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

paite: A guka a thilhih nakte utuh a gen leng a zumhuai ngala.
english: For the things which are done by them in secret, it is a shame even to speak of.

paite: Himahleh, thil bangkim a diklouhdan muhtheiha om tuh vak hihlat ahi nak hi; muhtheiha om peuhmah tuh vak ahi ngala.
english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

paite: Huaijiakin, Nang ihmu! hak inla, misi laka kipan thou in. Huchiin, Krisin vak honpe ding, chih ahi.
english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

paite: Huan, mi pil loute banga om louin, mi pilte banga om jawin, na omdan uah pilvang un;
english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise;

paite: Nite a hoih louh jiakin hun na neih sungun atam theipen sem jel un.
english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

paite: Huaijiakin hai nuam dah unla, Toupa deihlam bang ahia chih thei jaw un.
english: Therefore don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

paite: Huan, uain khamin om kei un, huaiah tuh kideklouhna a om ngala; Khaa dimin om jaw un,
english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

paite: Phatna late, Pathian late, khalam latea kihoupih chiata Toupa kianga na lungtang tengteng ua ging kilawm bawl leh lasain, leh.
english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing, and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

paite: I Toupa Jesu Kris mina, Pathian, Pa ngei kianga, bangkim tunga kipahthu gen gigein.
english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;

paite: Kris laudansiamin kiniamkhiak chiat un.
english: subjecting yourselves one to another in the fear of Christ.

paite: Jite aw, Toupa kianga na kiniamkhiak bang un, noumau pasalte kiangah kiniamkhiak un.
english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

paite: Kris tuh amah ngei pumpi hondampa hi a, saptuamte lutang a hih mahbangin, pasal tuh ji lutang ahi ngala.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, and Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

paite: Huchiin, saptuamte Kris kianga a kiniamkhiak mahbang un jite tuh bangkim ah a pasalte uh kiangah kiniamkhiak uhen.
english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

paite: Pasalte aw, na jite uh it un, Krisin saptuamte a ita, a sik ua a kipiak bangin,
english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;

paite: Huchia amau tuh tuia sila thua a hihsiangthou theihna dingin;
english: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,

paite: Huan, huchia, saptuamte tuh ninbang lou leh, vuai lou leh, huchibang thil mawngmawng pu loua, siangthou leh gensiatbeia om jawa, amah leh amah tuh saptuamte thupi taka a kipiak theihna dingin.
english: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

paite: Huchimahbangin pasalten leng amau pumpi mah bangin amau jite tuh a it ding uh ahi. Amah ji itpa tuh amah kiit ahi.
english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

paite: Kuamahin amah sa mah aho ngei ngal keia, a vakin a deihthoh zo nak hi, Krisin saptuamte a vaka a deihthoh mah bangin;
english: For no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly;

paite: A pumpi hiangte i hi ngal ua.
english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

paite: Huaijiakin pasalin a nu leh a pa paisanin a ji a len chinten dinga, huan, a nih un sa pumkhat a honghita ding uh.
english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will be joined to his wife. The two will become one flesh.” Genesis 2:24

paite: Hiai thuguk tuh a thupi hi, himahleh ken jaw Kris leh saptuamte thu ahi ka gen.Abang abang hileh, nou laka kuapeuhmah in amah a kiit bang in a ji it hen; ji mahin leng a pasal zahtak dingin pilvang hen.
english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and of the assembly.

paite: Abang abang hileh, nou laka kuapeuhmah in amah a kiit bang in a ji it hen; ji mahin leng a pasal zahtak dingin pilvang hen.
english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
